title: HIPAA Compliance Analysis: AlleDrops Quiz Data Storage
summary: Analyzes whether allergy quiz responses are HIPAA PHI and defines the resulting data-storage split between Shopify metafields and Google Sheets.
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=SPEC treated as authoritative. Content signals lean DOC/ADR-hybrid: prose legal analysis plus a stated 'Current Strategy' decision (treat quiz data as PHI; summary data in Shopify metafields, full 35-question responses in Google Sheets linked by profile ID). Carries binding non-functional constraints (BAA required for Google Workspace; Shopify is not HIPAA-compliant and must not hold PHI), which supports the SPEC designation. No 'Status: Accepted' marker, so locked=false. cross_refs are source-code paths, not sibling docs; external references are HHS, Shopify, and Google Workspace HIPAA URLs. Document explicitly defers final determination to a healthcare attorney, so downstream constraints should be flagged as pending legal confirmation.
